mechanism_notes: Reviewed exact final-size RGB PNG and matching immutable GitHub readback. Scoped credentials supply the sandbox separately from untrusted input. Agent uses wrapped tools; dispatcher exposes ticket identity, allowed repositories and path blocklist. Raw evidence branches outside agent context to independent risk check, whose verdict joins human review before protected branch. Sixteen exact labels, detached publisher caveat, no fake records/props/icons. Final secondary and priority labels readable; mobile fine text needs full-size view.
